about_the_game:
MouseMob allows you to create drag-and-drop regions on your screen and send mouse clicks and other actions to these areas using keyboard shortcuts.

✨ Features

🖱️ Add New Mouse Regions with Drag & Drop
Click the MouseMob icon in the bottom right and drag and drop your new mouse region anywhere on the screen.

No limits! You can add as many new mouse regions as you want.

⌨️ Powerful Shortcut Customization
Each new mouse region is automatically assigned a Numpad key (Num1, Num2...) as a shortcut.

You can easily change the shortcut key for any mouse region you want.

🎯 Multiple Mouse Actions
You can make your mouse perform 5 different actions with the assigned shortcut key:

Left Click, Right Click, Middle Click, and Mouse Wheel Up/Down.

💾 Save & Load
Save all your mouse regions, shortcut keys, and transparency setting with a single click.

Let your settings load automatically every time the application starts!

⚙️ Comprehensive Control
Hide/Show, Lock/Unlock, or completely delete all mouse regions from the screen with a single click.

You can also adjust the transparency of all regions as you wish!

🚀 Lightweight & Fast
Minimal system resource usage. No installation required. Just run it.

👥 Target Audience

Professionals & Everyday Users
Speed up repetitive tasks like graphic design, video editing, and data entry. Save time, increase productivity.

♿ Accessibility Support
It offers an effective alternative control method for users who have difficulty with intensive mouse use, making computer interaction easier.

💎 Summary

This user-friendly tool allows you to add square-shaped draggable mouse regions to your screen with a single click and assign custom keyboard shortcuts to them. Using these shortcuts, you can:

  • Send left, right, or middle-click commands to the mouse regions you've placed.

    Easily perform wheel scrolling actions.
